mapper.select:
select coalesce(sum(cs.actual_cost), 0) as totalSalesAmount
, coalesce( sum( case when cs.actual_start_time::date = current_date then cs.actual_cost end ), 0 ) as todaySalesAmount
, coalesce( round(avg(cs.actual_cost)), 0 ) as avgPaymentAmount
, coalesce( sum(cs.actual_kwh), 0 ) as totalKwh
, ( coalesce( sum( case when cs.actual_start_time::date = current_date then cs.actual_cost end ), 0 ) - coalesce( sum( case when cs.actual_start_time::date = current_date - interval '1 day' then cs.actual_cost end ), 0 ) ) as diffSalesAmount
from charging_session cs where cs.status = '완료' and cs.actual_start_time::date between #{startDate}::date and #{endDate}::date

select to_char( cs.actual_start_time::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) as salesDate
, coalesce( sum(cs.actual_cost), 0 ) as salesAmount
from charging_session cs where cs.status = '완료' and cs.actual_start_time::date between #{startDate}::date and #{endDate}::date
group by cs.actual_start_time::date order by cs.actual_start_time::date

select c.charger_type as chargerType
, coalesce( sum(cs.actual_cost), 0 ) as salesAmount
, round( sum(cs.actual_cost) * 100.0 / nullif( sum(sum(cs.actual_cost)) over(), 0 ), 1 ) as salesRate
from charging_session cs join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id
where cs.status = '완료' and cs.actual_start_time::date between #{startDate}::date and #{endDate}::date
group by c.charger_type order by salesAmount desc

select row_number() over( order by station_sales.sales_amount desc ) as rankNo
, station_sales.station_id as stationId , station_sales.station_name as stationName , station_sales.sales_amount as salesAmount , station_sales.payment_count as paymentCount , station_sales.total_kwh as totalKwh , station_sales.avg_payment_amount as avgPaymentAmount
, round( station_sales.sales_amount * 100.0 / nullif(sum(station_sales.sales_amount) over(), 0), 1 ) as salesRate
from ( select st.station_id , st.station_name
, coalesce( sum(cs.actual_cost), 0 ) as sales_amount
, count(*) as payment_count
, coalesce( sum(cs.actual_kwh), 0 ) as total_kwh
, coalesce( round(avg(cs.actual_cost)), 0 ) as avg_payment_amount
from charging_session cs join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id
where cs.status = '완료' and cs.actual_start_time::date between #{startDate}::date and #{endDate}::date
group by st.station_id , st.station_name ) station_sales
order by salesAmount desc limit 10

select cs.session_id as sessionId
, to_char( cs.actual_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) as paymentDate
, m.member_name as memberName , st.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName
, cs.actual_kwh as actualKwh , cs.actual_cost as actualCost , cs.status as status
from charging_session cs join app_member m on cs.member_id = m.member_id join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id
where cs.status = '완료' and cs.actual_start_time::date between #{startDate}::date and #{endDate}::date
order by cs.actual_start_time desc limit 20
